name: Jersey Club
about: Jersey club grew out of Baltimore club in Newark in the late 1990s and early 2000s, after DJ Tameil brought the Baltimore records home and he, Tim Dolla, Mike V and the Brick Bandits crew rebuilt them faster, harder and more chopped. The signatures are fixed: a bed-squeak sample, triplet kick runs, a vocal sliced into a stutter, and tempos around 135 to 140 BPM. The SoundCloud generation of the 2010s, DJ Sliink, Nadus, R3LL and UNIIQU3, turned it into a global remix style and a club format. Cookiee Kawaii's "Vibe" went viral in 2020, Mcvertt's beat for Lil Uzi Vert's "Just Wanna Rock" topped charts in 2022, Bandmanrill welded it to drill, and Drake and NewJeans borrowed it. Newark still owns it.

albums.title: Vibrate
albums.why: The Fool's Gold EP that introduced Newark's bed-squeaks and chopped vocals to the wider dance world, Sliink's calling card.

albums.title: Broke City
albums.why: A Pelican Fly EP where Jersey club's kicks carry real sadness; 'Nxwxrk' is the scene's most-loved instrumental and its emotional high-water mark.

albums.title: After Hours
albums.why: The Mixpak producer's debut runs Miami bass and freestyle through Jersey club's grid; a New York club record with Newark's rhythm in its bones.

albums.title: Club Soda, Vol. 1
albums.why: The EP around 'Vibe (If I Back It Up)', the TikTok hit that made Jersey club a pop reference point; brisk, flirty and over in minutes.

albums.title: Heartbeats
albums.why: A Local Action EP that gives the scene's most visible DJ a vocal, pop-leaning showcase without softening the kicks.

albums.title: Honestly, Nevermind
albums.why: A superstar's house detour with Jersey and Baltimore club kick patterns on 'Sticky' and 'Currents'; slight by his standards, huge for the scene's visibility.

albums.title: Club Godfather
albums.why: The Newark rapper's breakout tape puts drill cadences over Mcvertt's club beats and invents a lane in the process.

albums.title: Pink Tape
albums.why: A sprawling, uneven rock-rap album that matters here for 'Just Wanna Rock', the Mcvertt-produced Jersey club beat that reached number one.

albums.title: Get Up
albums.why: The K-pop group's EP built 'Super Shy' and 'ETA' on Jersey club rhythms, the style's biggest global crossover and a sleek one.

albums.title: Defiant Presents: Jiggy in Jersey
albums.why: The Jersey club drill summit on tape: three of its architects trading verses over squeaks and triplets, rough but definitive of the moment.

note: Jersey club's canon is singles, SoundCloud edits and EPs; this list is the handful of records that document it and the pop crossovers that carried it.
